status: Current accepted boundary-corrected implementation. Earlier verification.json and verification-final.json describe superseded versions rejected in focused review.
scope: Allow only paired inline MathJax delimiter additions to identical parenthesized text; retain all existing spans. Quote-aware HTML tokens and protected-element state prevent code/attribute edits; inline candidates cannot cross raw HTML boundaries; display state never hides HTML tags.
review_repairs: Quoted fake closing tags and quoted > must not terminate HTML tokens.
Inline or displayed math must not swallow an opening protected tag and permit changes inside code.

mutants.name: let whole display tokens hide HTML

generic.inventory_correction: current-mutant-inventory.txt lists 210 not-checked mutants. Earlier superseded ledgers miscounted this by one; selected/killed/survived counts are unchanged.

equivalent_for_verdict.inline_math_view__15: Constant translation of all span coordinates on both sides preserves equality and subset decisions.
equivalent_for_verdict.inline_math_view__102: Injective span re-encoding (start,end) -> (start,2*start-end) preserves all equality and subset decisions.
equivalent_for_verdict.presentation_equal__15: Identical plain text and span sets reconstruct identical raw strings, already handled by the early equality return; a genuine permitted addition is strict.
equivalent_for_verdict.violations__1: Disables only the fast path, leaving full comparison.
equivalent_for_verdict.violations__7: find and rfind agree on a valid notebook's unique research-record section.

cosmetic.violations__26: Changes only the nonempty historical-order finding label, retaining fail-closed status.

unmutated_control: current-control.txt; the current generic run also starts with clean tests

largest_notebook.method: Real largest notebook copies with one synthetic delimiter-only article difference; source notebook unchanged.

limits: Other mutation functions were not selected. Current code is not a general HTML validator or a broad inline-TeX linter; conservative refusal is allowed. The broad inline-tex-delimiter-guard remains queued and unimplemented. No speedup is claimed.
